channel.title: 5 Potential Ideas
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "5 Potential Ideas" - I feel like at least one of these has been done, and I still need to brainstorm details about all of them.

item.title: Admin Post - Info - Closed
item.content:encoded: Locking this thread as it's been years since the author has sought feedback on it.

item.title: Forum Crit Team - Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Yo, please don't respond to 6 year old critique forum threads randomly like this. There's no need to necropost in this case; and while your comment may technically be adding to the conversation, this isn't a case where adding to the conversation is worthwhile.

In addition, we expect feedback here to be relatively in depth: this comment would not be acceptable on a new thread either. I would recommend checking out: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-9804362/so-you-want-to-be-a-concept-reviewer if you want to have an actual go at being a reviewer.

item.title: Re: Potential Ideas?
item.content:encoded: I think 5 would make a good anomalous item, tho, if you'd expand it, it would be much more interesting and had a Scp potential.

item.title: Re: 5 Potential Ideas
item.content:encoded: You're actually right. I don't think I'll pursue this since I'm not a very depressing person. It would be extremely far from reality if I did make this into an SCP, but I'm not sure I could write this very well. Probably not.

item.title: Re: 5 Potential Ideas
item.content:encoded:
I might start working on four, but I'll need to work around with it because it seems like a tough write. I might incorporate the 5th in there as a sort of timer for the procedure.

The idea for 1, was going to detail the drug technically contrasting the diagnosis, but dis-benefit others by effecting their minds as well. Someone who has short term memory loss can steal memories from others, someone with multiple personalities can inflict a personality on someone else, or a person with a higher autism being able to say what others are thinking and feel their emotions. This would all be unintentional.
The advertising company would preach about how people should be born equal and how they can make nature fair with their high-tech surgery-bot that can 'cure' these people.
Do you think this is abstract enough? I want to play with morals but I don't want to make it too controversial. This is fiction after all.

item.title: Re: 5 Potential Ideas
item.content:encoded:
3. A person that overhears only negative thoughts pertaining to them, and does something to people who have ill-thinking that usually makes the SCP more depressed with guilt, and more unstable afterwards.

not only does this idea read a bit awkwardly, but from what i understand it also reads almost exactly like what i experience so im not sure id do anything but downvote it in good conscience unless you took that in a different and unique location that wasnt that close to reality (though what that direction would be im not sure)

item.title: Re: 5 Potential Ideas
item.content:encoded:
Opinions:

  • 2 and 5 are very boring.
  • 4 is really cliché, but could work with some very good, non-forward execution.
  • 1 is really shaky ground, considering how historically this has actually happened lots of times. There's some approaches where it could be entertaining, but it's still a touchy subject.
  • With 3 the problem also is that this is what many people experience when afflicted with depression or some other forms of mental illness. That could be a good thematic point, but if played too forward it could come off as tasteless.

item.title: Potential Ideas?
item.content:encoded:
So here are a few ideas I've had.

1. Advertised treatment to cure mental abnormalities actually makes the patients worse off. I actually put this up already but no one responded.

2. A creature that lives in your house with you, but you don't know it. I want to get creative with the Containment Procedures. It doesn't hurt anyone but it drains the food, moves objects around, unlocks doors, and basically makes all the tiny mistakes a shy roommate would make.

3. A person that overhears only negative thoughts pertaining to them, and does something to people who have ill-thinking that usually makes the SCP more depressed with guilt, and more unstable afterwards.

4. A suitcase with various items that will put you through a manic procedure all to erase someone from existence.

5. I'll expand on it, but is there a watch where it ticks at the same rate as your heartbeat anywhere?
